title: AWS CEO Matt Garman says AI safety can't rely on an "emergency brake" and that the same engineering discipline behind decades of secure systems applies to AI (Matt Garman/About Amazon)
summary: Matt Garman / About Amazon: AWS CEO Matt Garman says AI safety can't rely on an “emergency brake” and that the same engineering discipline behind decades of secure systems applies to AI — Most of the practical tools to build trustworthy AI systems already exist, and the industry needs to use them. — Key takeaways
contentText:
Matt Garman / About Amazon :

AWS CEO Matt Garman says AI safety can't rely on an “emergency brake” and that the same engineering discipline behind decades of secure systems applies to AI   —  Most of the practical tools to build trustworthy AI systems already exist, and the industry needs to use them.  —  Key takeaways
